raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Purpose

Clarify the comments in `Platform._align_hybrid_block_size()` so they describe
the actual `mamba_cache_mode` branches.

The existing comments describe the `"all"` branch as using prefix caching and
the `else` branch as not using prefix caching. This is misleading because
`mamba_cache_mode="align"` also operates with prefix caching enabled.

The updated comments distinguish:

- `"all"` mode
- `"none"` and `"align"` modes

This is a comment-only change and does not modify runtime behavior.

Closes #52895.

## Duplicate-work check

I searched existing issues and open PRs for the affected comments and Mamba
cache-mode terminology. I did not find an existing PR that updates these
comments.

Related PR #46778 documents Mamba/hybrid prefix caching more broadly, but it
does not modify the comments in `vllm/platforms/interface.py`.

- `"all"` mode
- `"none"` and `"align"` modes

This is a comment-only change and does not modify runtime behavior.

Closes #52895.

## Duplicate-work check

I searched existing issues and open PRs for the affected comments and Mamba

detail.title: [Docs] Clarify Mamba cache mode comments in hybrid block-size alignment

files.patch:
@@ -886,7 +886,7 @@ def _align_hybrid_block_size(
                 kernel_block_alignment_size = max(kernel_block_alignment_size, 128)
 
         if cache_config.mamba_cache_mode == "all":
-            # With prefix caching, align to mamba chunk size for kernel perf
+            # In "all" mode, align to the mamba chunk size for kernel perf
             # TODO(tdoublep): this constraint can be relaxed fairly
             # easily by changing the way we layout chunks in the
             # mamba2 kernels.
@@ -897,8 +897,8 @@ def _align_hybrid_block_size(
             attn_block_size = chunk_size * cdiv(attn_tokens_per_mamba_state, chunk_size)
             cache_config.mamba_block_size = attn_block_size
         else:
-            # Without prefix caching, use minimum block size that satisfies
-            # both backend alignment and mamba page size compatibility
+            # In "none" and "align" modes, use the minimum block size that
+            # satisfies both backend alignment and mamba page size compatibility
             attn_block_size = kernel_block_alignment_size * cdiv(
                 mamba_page_size,
                 kernel_block_alignment_size * attn_page_size_1_token,
